text: I ratify the WAIT trigger as written; it is my tier-2 trigger. W HH/HL, H1 HH/HL above EMA9, but D last_bar red at dist_to_20bar_high_pct 2.55: a heavy-volume break, away from the Creek. I stand behind a pull-in to the Creek (structure_shift_ref), then h1_close_above:bar_high on H1 (C3, C7). Wrong if a daily close back under pivot_high. oneil's pivot_high +5pct cap is not a test my method holds: my distance rule is about 1 ATR of the Creek (R2), and the pull-in already enforces it, so I neither need nor oppose the cap. reclaim:ma_20 is not a structural level I hold.
